name: cpig-71-map-toroidal
description: 71 Map Field Toroidal (R6.5 Phase E Batch 1 — Mapping)

setup.vlmDescription: A light-blue organic blob shape, roughly spherical but deformed, filling the viewport. Does NOT have a central hole. Identity verified by pixel-diff baseline, not VLM — confusable with Map Helical and a plain deformed sphere.
setup.whatItDoes: Wraps a source field around a torus surface. u runs around the major ring, v wraps around the tube cross-section, w is the radial offset.
setup.whatYouShouldSee: A light-blue organic blob. NOTE: the render does NOT show a donut/torus hole — the meshed isosurface is a closed organic volume. Identity verified by pixel-diff baseline, not VLM.

requires.fix: install the Slop yak package; on a dev machine a Release net48 build ships it to the Drive folder GH loads from - check `canary doctor` output for the location actually in use
install the CPig yak package, or on a dev machine build %CANARY_REPO_CPIG% CPig.Grasshopper (net48) and register its output folder in Grasshopper Developer Settings
this test loads a Slop definition from the CANARY_REPO_CPIG repo; check that repo out and point %CANARY_REPO_CPIG% at it (see workloads/tokens.json)
